summary: Tested Espace Pro CC2026 Opportunities and Events sections. All critical features working: 7 opportunities displayed with correct types (Booking, Business, Subvention, Formation, Emploi), 7 events displayed for 20-23 Mai 2026 with timeline view grouped by date, Postuler button opens application form and sends candidature, S'inscrire button registers for events successfully, filters by type work for both sections, Create opportunity modal functions correctly.

features_tested.GET_api_pro_opportunities: PASSED - Returns 7 real opportunities with all required fields
features_tested.Opportunities_Section_UI: PASSED - Shows 8 offers with type badges (Booking=terracotta, Business=gold, Formation=blue), deadline indicators (jours restants), Postuler buttons
features_tested.Events_Section_UI: PASSED - Timeline view grouped by date (20-23 Mai), type badges (Networking, Formation, Conférence, Concert, Atelier), S'inscrire buttons
features_tested.Postuler_Button: PASSED - Opens application form with textarea, Envoyer/Annuler buttons
features_tested.Application_Submit: PASSED - Sends candidature, shows 'Candidature envoyée!' toast
features_tested.S'inscrire_Button: PASSED - Registers user, shows 'Inscription confirmée!' toast, button changes to 'Inscrit'
features_tested.Create_Opportunity_Modal: PASSED - Opens with fields: Titre, Type, Date limite, Description, Prérequis, Localisation, Email contact
features_tested.Navigation_All_Sections: PASSED - Profile, Réseau Pro, Messages, Opportunités, Agenda all accessible
features_tested.Pro_Login_Flow: PASSED - request-access → get-code → verify-code → dashboard redirect

critical_code_review_comments: OpportunitiesSection correctly displays type badges with distinct colors (typeColors object)
EventsSection groups events by date in timeline view with dateByDate reduce
Postuler flow: clicking reveals textarea, Envoyer calls POST /api/pro/opportunities/{id}/apply
S'inscrire flow: click calls POST /api/pro/events/{id}/register, updates myRegistrations state
CreateOpportunityModal posts to /api/pro/opportunities with author_id and author_name from session
Double registration handled gracefully - API returns success=False with 'Déjà inscrit' message
All data-testid attributes present: nav-profile, nav-network, nav-messages, nav-opportunities, nav-events
